evidence.reason: The supplied Outbox.spool path validates and then atomically persists canonical(value) without any check against the ledger's per-record RECORD_BYTES limit. Because GitLedger.publish rejects an oversized pending record before publishing, a validation-legal but oversized review can be durably spooled and then permanently block later pending publication. This is an admission/publish invariant mismatch, not a new protection requirement; the smallest repair is to reject in spool when canonical(value) exceeds RECORD_BYTES, or add equivalent schema bounds.
